text: Computer science and technology is a discipline that studies "computing principles, information processing, and the construction of software and hardware systems". From the running logic of apps in mobile phones to the communication protocols of the internet, the algorithms of artificial intelligence, and the control systems of spacecraft, all of these fall within its research scope. It is hailed as "the cornerstone of the digital age", and the digital transformation of almost all industries relies on breakthroughs in computer technology - for instance, the low latency feature of 5G technology has promoted the popularization of remote medical services, and the advancement of deep learning algorithms has made autonomous driving move from concept to reality.
